r: To provide an inspirational, elevated luxurious shopping experience in order to make client dreams come true and maximize every sales opportunity. The ideal candidate should be a committed and organized team player, be conscientious and driven with at least 3/4 years sales experience within Bulgari or a similar role within luxury/fashion brand. x: To succeed within this role you should hold strong customer service and negotiation skills, work with integrity and respect to ensure operational effectiveness. Strong Business awareness and the ability to network for prospective clients outside of the store in order to enhance and build your client base is essential.
Knowledge of Bulgari products, Selling skills Store procedures is an advantage.

d: 🌟 We're Hiring: Hotel Finance Director / Hotel Financial Controller / Hospitality Finance Manager
q: We are a hospitality-focused organization committed to supporting financial performance, operational efficiency, and sustainable business growth. By combining sound financial management with industry knowledge and strategic planning, we aim to strengthen financial operations and support informed business decisions across the hospitality sector.

We are seeking an experienced hospitality finance professional to oversee financial planning, reporting, and performance management initiatives. This role will support financial control, budgeting, cost management, and business analysis to help hospitality operations maintain financial stability and achieve their commercial objectives.

Working remotely with flexible part-time hours, you will collaborate with management and relevant departments to review financial performance, identify improvement opportunities, and support effective financial decision-making.
Oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities.
Monitor revenue, operating expenses, cash flow, and overall financial performance.
Review financial statements and management reports to support business decisions.
Develop cost-control strategies and identify opportunities to improve profitability.
Monitor departmental budgets and analyze variances against financial targets.
Support financial policies, internal controls, and accounting procedures.
Coordinate with hotel operations and department leaders on financial matters.
Evaluate financial risks and recommend appropriate measures to strengthen controls.
Support month-end and year-end closing processes and financial reporting requirements.
Provide management with financial insights, forecasts, and recommendations for business improvement.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in hotel finance, hospitality accounting, or financial management preferred.
Strong understanding of hospitality financial operations, budgeting, and cost control.
Knowledge of financial reporting, cash flow management, and performance analysis.
Familiarity with hotel revenue streams, departmental expenses, and operational cost structures.
Proficiency in financial analysis, forecasting, and management reporting.
Ability to interpret financial data and communicate practical recommendations.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with remote teams.
Flexible part-time working hours with a fully remote arrangement.
Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
Opportunities to contribute to hospitality financial strategy and performance improvement.
Exposure to international hospitality business practices and financial initiatives.
Professional development in financial planning, reporting, and operational management.
A collaborative environment that values accountability, commercial awareness, and continuous improvement.
